description: Agent tasks. Checks: `facts` (each inner list: any one substring must be in the answer), `cite` (document key, optional page), `tools_required` (each inner list: at least one of these tools is called), `tools_forbidden`, `tool_order` (these tools appear in this order), `write` (the write tool that must be proposed, or null = none), `write_facts` (substrings the proposed write's arguments must contain), `agents` (agents that must appear in the trail), `abstain` (the documents don't contain the answer). Write proposals are approved, so the run is scored to the end.
